sources.outlet: Associated Press via NBC Los Angeles
sources.quote: About 20% of state-regulated high-hazard dams nationwide still lack emergency plans, according to the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, which maintains the national dam inventory.
sources.searcher_note: AP two-year investigation: 1,688 high-hazard dams in poor/unsatisfactory condition (2018 data); reports the EAP gap for all high-hazard dams, not the poor-condition subset.

sources.outlet: Associated Press via South Carolina Public Radio
sources.quote: The AP tallied more than 2,200 dams in poor or unsatisfactory condition that are rated as high hazard
sources.searcher_note: AP 2022 update on poor/high-hazard dam count; no EAP figures in this article.

sources.outlet: American Society of Civil Engineers, 2025 Report Card
sources.quote: (nearly 82% of state-regulated high hazard dams, about equal to 2021) have an EAP.
sources.searcher_note: National EAP coverage as of 2024 for all state-regulated high-hazard dams; also says ~15% (2,500+) of high-hazard dams are poor/unsatisfactory. No poor-and-no-EAP intersection.

sources.quote: The Commission did not have a complete and current emergency action plan for all dams that required them.
sources.searcher_note: Audit of TCEQ dam safety program: missing/stale EAPs in Texas, one of the lead's excess states. State-level pattern, no national count.

sources.quote: State and U.S. federal regulations require that dams classified as high hazard or significant hazard have emergency action plans in place.
sources.searcher_note: Most recent coverage found; cites 2,522 (about 15%) high-hazard dams in poor/unsatisfactory condition; no count of poor dams lacking EAPs.

notes: No source found that counts poor/unsatisfactory high-hazard dams lacking an emergency action plan, nationally or by state, and none reports the ~300 excess or the 634 figure. Coverage found is the two halves separately: AP 2019/2022 counts of poor high-hazard dams, and national EAP coverage (~80-82% of state-regulated high-hazard dams have one). WUNC 2022 (wunc.org/news/2022-06-01/...) reports 194 NC poor/high-hazard dams, no EAP numbers; not recorded. WFMJ Youngstown 2025-06-10 Watchdog Report lists local poor/high-hazard dams with a Yes/No column (e.g. 'Pleasant Valley Lake Dam: Poor, High, No.') but the column legend is not in the page text, so not recorded as a source. No coverage dated after 2026-06-30 found. No disagreeing source found.
